{{Quote|Down, Seventeen, it is not feeding time yet.|"Doctor" tactical droid|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref>}}
'''Seventeen''' was a genetically engineered creature created by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente's]] modified [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]], "[[Doctor (tactical droid)|Doctor]]."

==Biology and appearance==
He was a genetic hybrid of at least three different separate species. He had the head of a [[Blarth/Legends|blarth]], with the tusks of a [[boma]] and one eye of a [[cannok]]. His front legs were those of a boma while his body and hind legs were that of a cannok. His tail was a boma's that ended in the tip of a blarth's tail.
